newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DISPUTED KIKO GOAL GIVES ATLETICO CUP BREATHING SPACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DISPUTED KIKO GOAL GIVES ATLETICO CUP BREATHING SPACE.

text.p: Spanish Cup holders Atletico Madrid will take a comfortable 2-0 lead to next week's fourth round, second leg tie with Compostela thanks to a hotly-disputed goal by Kiko Narvaez in the dying minutes of Wednesday's first leg.

In other games second-division Lleida held Celta Vigo to a 1-1 draw, and struggling Extremadura fought back from 2-0 down to earn a 2-2 draw at Rayo Vallecano. Cup specialists Athletic Bilbao went down to a solitary late goal at Racing Santander.

Atletico went ahead through an eighth-minute strike by Toni Munoz, but were set for an uncomfortable return leg until Kiko's goal, which was given as good despite the fact that a linesman was clearly waving for offside.
The enraged Compostela manager Fernando Vazquez had to be restrained from approaching the referee at the end of the game.
The big Barcelona-Real Madrid game and Tenerife's clash with Real Betis are scheduled to complete the fourth round, first leg games on Thursday.
